body:
Hi team,
Congratulations on publishing ASVS v5!

I’ve started the Ukrainian translation for the latest version. While the work is in its early stages, I wanted to open this issue to notify you and align with the contribution process.

Please let me know if there’s anything I should share; thanks

comments.body:
Hi,

just in case, to be sure - please follow: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#translations

Especially, 
> Note that we are ONLY accepting translations based on markdown and not preformatted translations in Word or PDF format to make tracking and maintainance easier.

... but maybe that is why you opened an issue :)
Thank you, I'll follow the CONTRUBUTING guide
Hi @teraGL, just to emphasise to make sure you base your translation on the [v5.0.0](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/tree/v5.0.0/5.0/en) branch and open a pull request against that branch.

title: Ukrainian translation of ASVS v5
